scope: Retrospective paired success turnover at20k. No new training or evaluation. Protocol written before this analysis, but historical outcomes have been seen: exploratory, not preregistered confirmation.
outcome_split: SHA256 F07-v1|suite|task|initial_state_hash; first50 D, last50 O. Paired by bank/task/initial state, not episode row position. D only as predictor; O only scoring.
features: Per task lost=P0=1,P20=0; gained=P0=0,P20=1. Excess turnover=min(lost,gained)/50=lost/50-max(p0-p20,0). It is the single extra degree of freedom beyond marginal successes, not two independent factors. Upper bound min(p0,p20,1-p0,1-p20). Conditional lost/initial_success missing if initial_success=0.
profile: Focus task first, remaining tasks sorted by (p0,p20,task index); Uniform all tasks sorted. Four initial rates, four deltas and four positive declines plus focus/cp400 indicators. No task/suite/seed labels. Margins and their nonlinear decline are controlled before turnover is added.
half_panel_sensitivity: Divide already outcome-independent ordered D50 into first25/last25 for turnover only, keeping all baseline D50 features. Marginal differences can affect half-panel metrics, so these are reliability sensitivities, not alternative primary effects.
prediction: Target SAME-branch D40 macro minus D20 macro. Weighted ridge with fold-only standardization, penalty1 in weighted mean loss, unpenalized intercept. Leave out one original seed across all suites/checkpoints. No tuning. Predict D20+remainder. No clipping.
selection: Primary choose among5 same-continuation20k diagnostics and score same actual continuation40k O. Secondary use mean predictions of other2 continuations and score held third. Uniform, Failure(parentD), Greedy20, Development_fixed(other2 original seeds D40 same suite/checkpoint) controls. Ties Uniform then task order tol1e-12.
weighting: A/B/C equally; A200/A400 equally within A; original seeds and continuations equally. 12 contexts,9 parent histories,3 original seed blocks,180 branch rows.
uncertainty: Joint task-wise O-case bootstrap with all models/choices fixed. Does not include training, fitting, D-case or diagnostic-choice uncertainty. No population significance with3 seed blocks.
screen: Exploratory triage: primary increment>=1pp, positive in>=2 original seeds, no group below-2pp. Does not authorize promotion without independent small-probe confirmation and cost-inclusive comparison.
costs: New environment/learner steps0. Historical same-repeat diagnostics require5x20k=100k training, plus20k selected continuation=120k; cross-repeat10x20k plus independent40k=240k. Count parentD and all probeD evaluation lengths separately. They cannot be claimed to fit40k total budget.
